name: Nanhua Futures Co., Ltd.
summary: Nanhua Futures Co., Ltd., incorporated in 1996 and based in Hangzhou, provides futures brokerage, wealth management, risk management and investment consulting services in China and abroad. Its businesses include commodity and financial futures brokerage, asset management, fund agency services, over-the-counter derivatives, market making, securities brokerage and foreign exchange trading. It is a subsidiary of Hengdian Group Holding Co., Ltd.
